title: Recover Non-Recoverable Operator Station Motor Fault by Stopping Cycle and Pressing RESET
summary: For non-recoverable operator station motor faults (e.g., motor overload) that cannot be recovered in software, stop the tipping cycle from the operator station HMI and press RESET to clear the fault.
when_to_use: Use when the operator station shows a non-recoverable motor fault (example given: motor overload) and the fault must be manually reset because it cannot be recovered via software.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Stop the tipping cycle and press RESET on the operator station HMI to clear the non-recoverable motor fault.

system_preconditions: A non-recoverable operator station motor fault is present (example: motor overload).

steps.title: Navigate to MCP_Dual screen (F3) on the operator station HMI
steps.purpose: Open the operator station screen that contains the controls needed to stop the tipping cycle and reset the non-recoverable fault.
steps.instruction: On the operator station HMI, navigate to the "MCP_Dual" screen (F3).
steps.expected_result: The "MCP_Dual" screen is displayed on the operator station HMI.
steps.healthy_condition: The MCP_Dual screen is visible and shows the manual mode fault context (e.g., Manual Mode Fault indicator) where applicable.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot reach the MCP_Dual screen (F3), or the required controls (CYCLE STOP / RESET) are not visible.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 1. On the operator station HMI, navigate to the "MCP_Dual" screen (F3).

steps.title: Press CYCLE STOP to stop the tipping cycle
steps.purpose: Stop the tipping cycle before attempting to reset a non-recoverable motor fault.
steps.instruction: On the MCP_Dual screen, press "CYCLE STOP" to stop the tipping cycle.
steps.expected_result: The tipping cycle is stopped after pressing CYCLE STOP.
steps.healthy_condition: The system is no longer running the tipping cycle (cycle is halted) after CYCLE STOP is pressed.
steps.failure_condition: Pressing CYCLE STOP does not stop the tipping cycle.

actions.label: Stop tipping cycle
actions.exact_action: Press "CYCLE STOP" to stop the tipping cycle.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 2. Press CYCLE STOP to stop the tipping cycle.

steps.title: Press RESET to clear the non-recoverable fault (manual mode)
steps.purpose: Manually reset the non-recoverable operator station motor fault so it no longer remains in the manual fault state.
steps.instruction: If the fault is shown in manual mode, press "RESET" to reset the fault.
steps.expected_result: The non-recoverable fault clears after pressing RESET (fault no longer remains in the manual fault state).
steps.healthy_condition: The Manual Mode Fault indicator is cleared after pressing RESET.
steps.failure_condition: The fault remains in the manual fault state after pressing RESET.
stop_or_escalate_if: If pressing RESET does not clear the fault or the system remains in the fault/manual state, escalate to FORTNA support for further troubleshooting.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: To reset the fault, press RESET.
If a fault occurs that is not able to be recovered via software, such as a motor overload fault, the station needs to be manually reset.

success_criteria: Tipping cycle is stopped after pressing CYCLE STOP.
Non-recoverable motor fault clears after pressing RESET (fault no longer remains in the manual fault state).
healthy_conditions: Manual Mode Fault indicator is cleared after RESET.
failure_conditions: Fault remains in manual fault state after pressing RESET.
Tipping cycle does not stop after pressing CYCLE STOP.
escalation_guidance: If pressing RESET does not clear the fault or the system remains in the fault/manual state, escalate to FORTNA support for further troubleshooting.
